title: Price formatting crashes on unsafe numeric input
failingStep: Step 5: Click the 'Summary' step in the progress bar
reason: The current page shows a client-side application error and contains no Summary progress-bar step.

verdict.title: Price formatting crashes on unsafe numeric input
verdict.oneLiner: The page crashes before the Summary step can be shown, so the requested progress-bar action cannot be completed.
verdict.rootCause: The app tried to turn a number that is too large or too small into a displayed price, and it stopped the whole page instead of handling that value safely.
verdict.suggestion: Fix the price-formatting path to validate or safely handle out-of-range values, and keep the checkout progress bar available if one value cannot be displayed.

rejectedBecause: Duplicate of BUG-001: the same crash in the price formatter when a line total exceeds JavaScript's safe integer range, reached the same way (huge rate × quantity).
